verdict_reason: Several new follow-up rows name pre-rename classes and fields and one deploy-row claim about old addresses is no longer true, so the follow-ups would send someone to code that is gone or already fixed.

todos.issue: Rows this PR adds describe the address book as it was before the same PR set's roles rename, so the follow-ups point at code that no longer exists or is already fixed. Line 25: OperatorMapperTest (now AddressMapperTest). Line 28: address-book AddressType's @Schema (AddressType is gone; RoleGroup.java and AddressRole.java replace it). Line 30: fields.js storedTypeAndUsesOf (now storedRolesOf, fields.js:53) and edit.controller.js (now edit/edit.controller.js); its claim 'an old address lists only on the Origin and Consignor tab, with a blank Type column' is false now: AddressListQueryImpl.java:37-39 matches only roles, the no-uses fallback is gone and the stored field is roles (Address.java:21-22, 61), so an address saved before the rename lists on no tab. Line 31: 'accepts a create or update whose uses do not belong to its type' and OperatorService/Controller Javadoc (AddressRequest now carries @RolesHeldTogether; AddressService/AddressController). Line 33: give the stub seeds 'a type and uses' (stub.js:31 and typed-seed.js already give roles).
todos.fix: Must: every open row in deferred.md names files, classes and behaviour as they are at the PR set's merge commits, a row whose work the PR set already did is closed, and the deploy row states what a pre-rename address does now (on no tab). One way: re-check rows 25, 28, 30, 31 and 33 against the address-book and ins-frontend branches, rename Operator*/AddressType/storedTypeAndUsesOf/uses to their current names, mark the type-uses check and the stub-seed item Done if RolesHeldTogether and the roles seeds cover them, and reword line 30's 'Until cleared' sentence.
